caption:
Koko pads around the house barefoot, and now there's a pebble-like ache under her second toe.

Under the toe joints sits the plantar plate, a tough band of tissue. Lots of time barefoot or in thin shoes on hard floors can load this area. Firmer-soled shoes and indoor shoes are often a good first step.

Hybi's 1-minute care: press your toes into the floor for 5 seconds × 10, then a calf stretch for 30 seconds × 3. Stop if pain gets worse.

A toe that starts to drift, swelling, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
